answer: The echo multiplier is published, charged in mirror, and willow lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 2440 identities would post 3708 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
